name: manual_278bd7
claim: When auditing Markdown links, skip fenced code and custom URI schemes, preserve append-only historical ledgers, and repair only resolvable live-document paths; otherwise a code literal or historical record can be mistaken for a red link.

decisions.notes: The May RAG FTS5 regex contained a literal bracket-parenthesis sequence that looked like Markdown to a naive scanner. A fence-aware audit found the real navigation defects without rewriting preserved historical lesson evidence.
